title: 第一章：复仇者
content_zh:
夜晚时分，一座繁华中透漏着浮躁的二线城市。
街道上车水马龙，夜生活的开始，让许多年轻人从闷热的房间中逃出，尽情挥霍着时光。
苏晓蹲坐在一栋二层别墅的房顶，夜风吹过，让他感觉到一阵凉爽。
身穿黑衣的苏晓，将身形隐藏在房顶的黑暗中，更何况他还戴着宽大的黑色兜帽。
这身装束在酷热的夏天，就算是夜晚，也会让人感觉到闷热。
但对于苏晓来说，这都是小事，他已经在此等候两个小时，与他那不幸的经历相比，这不算什么。
以苏晓现在的年纪，本应在大学中度过美好时光，可他却因为仇恨，在三年前放弃了学业，开始学习一些其他知识。
人体解刨学、格斗、快速开锁等知识。
漫长的等待开始，苏晓在等他的仇人。
两小时后，一辆黑色豪车缓缓驶入别墅院内，沉闷的引擎声熄灭，车门
可能是因为过量饮酒，中年人的脚步明显有些虚浮。
别墅房顶的苏晓，拿起身边的一把长刀，长刀出鞘，刀身乌黑，借助夜色让人很难察觉。
纵身从五米高的房顶跃下，苏晓那灵活的手臂，在空中抓住别墅上突出的菱角，将下落的速度减缓。
平稳落地，苏晓落在了仇人的正前方。
没有任何废话，苏晓手中的长刀划破空气，发出一阵呜咽声后，一刀将仇人的喉咙斩开。
鲜血喷涌而出，虽然苏晓极力躲避，但袖口与手背依然被鲜血侵染。
已经醉酒的仇人，还没明白发生了什么，已经仰倒在地。
这种伤势与死亡无异，所以苏晓马上向人烟稀少的位置奔跑。
余光扫过，苏晓看到一名身穿制服的保安。
虽然他正在行凶，但被人当场目击也无所谓，他将相貌隐藏的很好。

可在下一刻，苏晓的寒毛直竖，那名保安居然在腰间拔出一把枪，黑黝黝的手枪，枪身修长，明显是装载了消音器械。
保安怎么可能有枪，苏晓已经来不及仔细思考。
身后是至少十几面宽的别墅，那名保安距离他大概有二十米，如果选择逃，背后就彻底暴露给敌人，那就成了活靶子。
遇到危险，苏晓的第一反应是解决危险的源头，绝不是逃。
挺身向前冲去，苏晓成s形奔跑，尽可能避免被枪击。
“噗、噗、噗……。”
安装了消音器的手枪，只发出微弱的枪声。
苏晓才冲出五米远左右，就感觉小腿一麻，之后胸口传来同样的感觉。
苏晓知道这是中枪了，虽然他是个复仇者，但他并没中过枪。
无力的感觉在身体蔓延，苏晓并没有恐惧，只是有些不甘而已。
复仇还没完成，他就已经倒下，而且是被未知的敌人杀掉，这是多么窝囊的一件事。
用尽最后力气，苏晓将手中的长刀抛出。
这一刀基本是听天由命，但老天仿佛察觉到苏晓的不甘，以及他那不公的遭遇，那把长刀在空中飞速旋转几圈后，竟奇迹般刺入到持枪保安的胸口。
瘫倒在地的苏晓，脸上露出笑容。
那把长刀他淬了神经性毒素，而且是混合类，那名被刺伤的保安必死无疑。
意识开始模糊，苏晓感觉头部遭到重击，之后眼前漆黑一片。
在最后残存的意识中，苏晓隐约听到。
“猎杀者，‘轮回乐园’为你开启。”
--------------
【身体传输中……】

【10%、50%、100%，传输完成，检核到猎杀者身体受到大量损伤，等修复……。】
【猎杀者意识未苏醒，修复指令延后，现维持最低生存状态，维持时间十分钟……。“
【滴…滴…，发现猎杀者天赋为成长天赋，生存时间追加两小时。】
一片黑暗中，几排淡蓝色文字漂浮在半空，发出淡淡的微光。
在淡蓝色文字下方，苏晓满身血迹的躺在虚空中。
手指抽动，苏晓悠悠醒来。
在醒来后，苏晓先是有些茫然，但回忆起那黑洞洞的枪口后，马上想站起身。
剧痛传来，苏晓痛的险些再次昏厥。
费力的坐起身，苏晓扫视周围，除了几行闪着蓝光的文字，四周漆黑一片。
【猎杀者，欢迎来到‘轮回乐园’】
一行文字凭空出现在苏晓面前，但苏晓并没去看那一行文字，而是开始检查身体的伤势。
小腿被击穿，伤口处皮肉翻卷，手指都能轻易探入其中。
这种血腥的情景，苏晓只是眉头皱起，并没有其他表现。
他经历过比这残酷十倍的情景，所以这些并不能让他动容。
胸口处的伤势更加严重，但无论是小腿或胸口处的伤势，都没流出血迹。
“我没死？”
将手按在胸口，苏晓感觉到心脏在有力的跳动。
【猎杀者，你并没有死亡，是/否愿意加入‘轮回乐园’，这里有你想要的一切。】
苏晓早就注意到那些可疑的文字，但出于对未知事物的警惕，他并没理会那些文字。
现在的情况有些诡异，他受了必死的伤势，却奇迹般的活了下来，而且在他身旁，有一行血红色的数字正在倒数。

【1：35：10】，【1：35：9】……。
一小时三十五分零九秒，如果苏晓没猜错，这就是那些数字的意思，而且数字还在不停倒计时。
这血红色数字，给苏晓一种不祥的感觉，仿佛在这些数字归零时，将会发生很不好的事。
【猎杀者，请尽快与‘乐园’沟通，以签订契约，否则你将在‘1小时35分’后死亡】
果然，那些数字代表了他还能存活的时间，苏晓之前就有所猜测，他的伤势太重，早就应该死亡。
“我的刀呢。”
苏晓没有在乎什么‘契约’或‘乐园’，而是向对方索要他的刀。
那把刀是他父母留给他唯一的纪念，据说是他太爷爷缴获的一把军官刀，一直传到他这一代。
【现实物品无法带入‘乐园’中，请尽快签订契约。】
苏晓沉默，淡蓝色文字闪动，可能是没遇到过苏晓这种‘猎杀者’。
“契约？说说看，我需要付出什么，又能得到什么。”
逐渐减少的生存时间，让苏晓没有太多时间去耽搁，而且他感觉，他应该是遇到了什么‘超自然’事件，这让他的内心有些波动。
苏晓很需要力量去复仇，而‘超自然’事件在伴随巨大风险的同时，也可能获得非同寻常的力量。
【签订契约，你将穿梭在一个个‘衍生位面’中，去完成‘轮回乐园’发布的任务，获得‘世界之源’，最终以‘世界之源’的多少，来恒定奖励是否丰富。】
【‘轮回乐园’无所不能。】
大量文字浮现，苏晓仔细的着。
“无所不能？能复生故去的人？”
所有淡蓝色文字忽然静止在半空，之后全部隐去。
【鉴于你猎杀者的身份，不能。】
(三七中文 et)
content_en:
At night, a second-tier city is bustling with impetuousness.
The streets are busy with traffic, and the beginning of nightlife makes many young people escape from their stuffy rooms and waste their time.
Su Xiao squatted on the roof of a two-story villa, and the night wind blew by, making him feel cool.
Su Xiao, who was wearing black clothes, hid his figure in the darkness on the roof, not to mention that he was also wearing a wide black hood.
This outfit will make people feel stuffy even at night in the scorching summer.
But for Su Xiao, this is all a trivial matter. He has been waiting here for two hours. Compared with his unfortunate experience, this is nothing.
At Su Xiao's current age, he should have spent a good time in college, but because of hatred, he gave up his studies three years ago and started to learn some other knowledge.
Knowledge of human anatomy, fighting, quick lock picking, etc.
The long wait begins, Su Xiao is waiting for his enemy.
Two hours later, a black luxury car slowly drove into the villa courtyard, the dull sound of the engine was extinguished, and the car door opened
Perhaps due to excessive drinking, the middle-aged man's steps were obviously a little frivolous.
Su Xiao, who was on the roof of the villa, picked up a long knife next to her. The long knife was unsheathed. The blade was so black that it was difficult to detect with the help of the night.
Jumping from the five-meter-high roof, Su Xiao's flexible arms grabbed the protruding water chestnut on the villa in the air to slow down her fall.
Landing smoothly, Su Xiao landed directly in front of the enemy.
Without any nonsense, the long knife in Su Xiao's hand cut through the air, and after a whimper, he cut open the enemy's throat with one knife.
Blood spurted out, and although Su Xiao tried his best to avoid it, the cuffs and back of his hands were still stained with blood.
The drunken enemy fell to the ground before he understood what was happening.
This kind of injury was no different from death, so Su Xiao immediately ran to a sparsely populated location.
Looking out of the corner of his eye, Su Xiao saw a security guard in uniform.
Although he was committing murder, it didn't matter if he was witnessed on the spot. He hid his appearance very well.
But at the next moment, Su Xiao's hair stood on end. The security guard actually pulled out a gun from his waist. It was a dark pistol with a long body, and it was obviously equipped with a silencer.
How could the security guard have a gun? Su Xiao had no time to think carefully.
Behind him was a villa that was at least a dozen wide. The security guard was about twenty meters away from him. If he chose to escape, his back would be completely exposed to the enemy and he would become a living target.
When encountering danger, Su Xiao's first reaction is to solve the source of the danger, not to escape.
Standing up and rushing forward, Su Xiao ran in an S shape, trying to avoid being shot as much as possible.
"Puff, puff, puff..."
The silencer-equipped pistol produced only a faint sound.
Su Xiao just rushed about five meters away when she felt numbness in her calf, and then the same feeling came from her chest.
Su Xiao knew that he had been shot. Although he was an Avenger, he had never been shot.
The feeling of powerlessness spread throughout the body. Su Xiao was not afraid, but just a little unwilling.
Before his revenge was completed, he had already fallen and was killed by an unknown enemy. What a coward.
Using his last strength, Su Xiao threw the long knife in his hand.
This knife was basically left to fate, but God seemed to be aware of Su Xiao's unwillingness and his unfair experience. After the long knife spun several times in the air, it miraculously penetrated into the chest of the gun-wielding security guard.
Lidya Su collapsed to the ground with a smile on his face.
The long knife was tempered with neurotoxins, and it was a mixed type. The stabbed security guard was bound to die.
Su Xiao's consciousness began to blur, and Su Xiao felt a heavy blow on the head, and then everything went dark.
In the last remaining consciousness, Su Xiao heard vaguely.
"Hunter, the 'Reincarnation Paradise' is opened for you."
---------------
[Body transfer in progress...]
【10%, 50%, 100%, the transmission is completed, and it is verified that the hunter's body has suffered a lot of damage, waiting for repair... 】
[The hunter's consciousness has not yet awakened, and the repair command has been delayed. The minimum survival state is currently maintained for ten minutes... "
[Beep...beep..., it was discovered that the hunter's talent is a growth talent, and the survival time is increased by two hours. 】
In the darkness, several rows of light blue text floated in the air, giving off a faint glow.
Under the light blue text, Su Xiao was lying in the void covered in blood.
Her fingers twitched, and Su Xiaoyou woke up.
After waking up, Su Xiao was a little confused at first, but after recalling the black muzzle, she immediately wanted to stand up.
Severe pain came, and Su Xiao almost fainted again from the pain.
Sitting up with difficulty, Su Xiao glanced around. Except for a few lines of text with blue light, the surroundings were dark.
[Hunter, welcome to the ‘Reincarnation Paradise’]
A line of text appeared in front of Su Xiao out of thin air, but Su Xiao did not read the line of text, but began to check the body's injuries.
The calf was penetrated, and the skin and flesh of the wound were rolled up, and fingers could easily penetrate into it.
Su Xiao only frowned at this bloody scene and had no other expression.
He'd been through situations ten times crueler than this, so they didn't move him.
The injury on the chest was more serious, but there was no blood from the injuries on the calf or chest.
"I'm not dead? "
Putting her hand on her chest, Su Xiao felt her heart beating vigorously.
[Hunter, you are not dead. Y/N is willing to join the ‘Reincarnation Paradise’. There is everything you want here. 】
Su Xiao had noticed the suspicious words a long time ago, but out of wariness of unknown things, he ignored them.
The current situation is a bit strange. He suffered fatal injuries, but miraculously survived, and beside him, there was a line of blood-red numbers counting down.
[1:35:10], [1:35:9]….
One hour, thirty-five minutes and nine seconds. If Su Xiao guessed correctly, this is what those numbers mean, and the numbers are still counting down.
These blood-red numbers gave Su Xiao an ominous feeling, as if something bad would happen when these numbers returned to zero.
[Hunter, please communicate with ‘Paradise’ as soon as possible to sign a contract, otherwise you will die in ‘1 hour and 35 minutes’]
Sure enough, those numbers represented how long he could survive. Su Xiao had guessed before that his injuries were too serious and he should have died long ago.
"Where's my knife. "
Su Xiao didn't care about the 'contract' or 'paradise', but asked the other party for his knife.
That knife was the only souvenir left to him by his parents. It was said to be an officer's knife captured by his great-grandfather, and it has been passed down to his generation.
[Real items cannot be brought into the ‘Paradise’, please sign the contract as soon as possible. 】
Su Xiao was silent, and the light blue text flashed. Maybe he had never encountered a 'hunter' like Su Xiao.
"Contract? Let’s talk about what I need to pay and what I can get. "
The gradually decreasing survival time left Su Xiao without much time to delay, and he felt that he should have encountered some 'supernatural' event, which made his heart fluctuate a little.
Su Xiao needs strength to take revenge, and while 'supernatural' events are accompanied by huge risks, they may also gain extraordinary power.
[Signing the contract, you will travel through the 'derivative planes' to complete the tasks released by the 'Reincarnation Paradise' and obtain the 'Source of the World'. In the end, the richness of the reward will be determined by the amount of 'Source of the World'. 】
[‘Reincarnation Paradise’ is omnipotent. 】
A large amount of text appeared, and Su Xiao read it carefully.
"Omnipotent? A dead person who can be resurrected? "
All the light blue text suddenly stopped in mid-air, and then disappeared.
[Given your status as a hunter, you cannot. 】
(Sanqi Chinese et)
